title: helm(private): add init hooks and strict values schema for Redwood Private installer
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Private deployments need deterministic install/upgrade behavior for on-prem and VPC customers. This PR introduces a stricter values schema for the `private` chart, adds init/upgrade hooks for DB migrations and KS secret bootstrapping, and improves templating around tolerations/affinity and image pull policies. The goals are: 1) fail-fast on invalid values via a JSON Schema (values.schema.json), 2) ensure required init jobs run once and can be retried safely on upgrade, 3) make chart defaults safer for air-gapped/on-prem installs (nodeSelector, imagePullPolicy, PV resize settings), and 4) document upgrade/rollback steps in NOTES.txt. Changes include: values.schema.json for the private chart, a pair of init job templates (init-db-job and init-secrets-job) implemented as Helm hooks (pre-install, pre-upgrade) with idempotency guards, updated values.yaml defaults, helper template snippets for tolerations/affinity, and a short upgrade doc included in the chart package. This is intended to be backwards-compatible for most installs; when users opt into the new strict schema there may be failures for undocumented value keys (see release notes).

review_comments: Ethan Park (2025-11-06): Nice work. Two requests: make the init jobs idempotent if they run twice during a failed upgrade, and add a short timeout + backoff to avoid long hangs on k8s api issues.
Priya Nair (2025-11-06): Addressed both requests - added a lightweight lock ConfigMap guard and a 5m activeDeadlineSeconds with exponential backoff comment in template.
Sofia Rivera (2025-11-08): values.schema.json looks good. Please add a NOTE about strict schema mode in NOTES.txt and call out behaviour for unknown keys (fail vs warn).
Priya Nair (2025-11-09): Updated NOTES.txt to document schema validation behavior and how to opt into the strict check; added migration note for existing installs.
Martin Liu (2025-11-11): CI initially failed on the integration suite due to network egress in the runner - reran jobs and all checks passed. Approving to merge once CI green.
Ethan Park (2025-11-12): LGTM - approving and leaving a release note suggestion to highlight upgrade step for operators.
release_notes: Add strict values schema and init hooks for Redwood Private chart. Operators should review NOTES.txt for upgrade steps; default behavior is backwards-compatible but enabling strict schema may require supplying missing keys. See chart CHANGELOG for details.
